23                Mr. President, this has been 

24   commonly referred to as the breast density bill.  

25   And to my colleagues, I appreciate anyone who 

                                                                5662

 1   will be voting in favor of this.  

 2                A lot of times we get legislation 

 3   that we introduce as a result of things that 

 4   happen to people in an adverse way.  And I have 

 5   had the privilege and good fortune of meeting a 

 6   woman named JoAnn Pushkin from my home community 

 7   who, as a result of a misreading and an improper 

 8   diagnosis, has had to battle cancer for a number 

 9   of years.  She's doing well.  She's a delightful 

10   individual.  And she has channeled her energies 

11   into working on issues like this.

12                And this is one of the few times I 

13   feel comfortable getting up and saying even 

14   though someone will say this is an insurance 

15   mandate, I firmly believe that this will save 

16   costs in the long run.  Because you're going to 

17   get better readings, you're going to get better 

18   information, and this is more in the line of 

19   prevention and getting something addressed before 

20   something negative happens rather than after the 

21   fact.  

22                This issue is gaining a lot of 

23   notoriety across the country.  New York, by 

24   passing this law, will be ahead of many other 

25   states.

 1                And I will say this.  I've learned a 

 2   lot about this issue in talking to people, and 

 3   particularly advocates in this area.  And one 

 4   thing that really struck me more than anything 

 5   else is that most women are unaware of this whole 

 6   issue.  There are roughly 50 percent of women who 

 7   have, quote, unquote, dense breasts, and many of 

 8   them don't even know that.  So the notice

10   will go a long way towards protecting women 

11   hopefully not only just in this state but across 

12   the country.
